0022600221.text: The Grizzlies (7-3, 5-0 on the road, 2-3 at home, on a W1 streak) host the Denver Nuggets (5-4, on an L1 streak) in Memphis' 11th game of the season. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Grizzlies lost the season series 1-3, including a 136-119 loss in Denver on April 8, 2026. Memphis is missing Richie Saunders (out, knee, surgery) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (out, back soreness), while Isaiah Stewart (knee bruise) and Quinten Post (head) are day-to-day with game-time decisions. Denver is without Julian Strawther (out, knee sprain).
